messages:
Maya R: Heads-up: compiling action items from last week's multi-region flakiness. Want a tight follow-up thread to track owners + hard dates. Key buckets: routing policy drift, backup verification gaps, restore runbook clarity, and recurring traffic spike pattern investigation.
Ivan L: I can take routing policy drift. Plan: diff current edge tables vs. golden config and push a cleanup PR. ETA: 4 business days. Need a reviewer from netops.
Priya S: I'll own backup verification. Two steps: (1) surface failures in the nightly job, (2) add a smoke restore in the sandbox. Target: spike PR by Tue, smoke restore script by Fri.
Ben J: For the restore runbook, we should split into Quick Recovery (5-15m) vs Full Restore (>2h). I'll draft both sections. Can we aim for a draft by Wed?
Maya R: Good split, Ben. Make Quick Recovery the tabletop focus. We need a 45m drill that goes from detection -> route fail -> quick-restore verification.
Ivan L: Netops reviewer pinged: @netops-team. Also, routing change needs a safe-play gadget (dry-run) so we don't flip the wrong prefixes during the drill. Requesting perms for testing route-tool.
ops-bot: Created ticket INC-7341 "dr-routing-drift-cleanup" and linked to tracker: https://intra.redwood/trackers/dr-action-items/INC-7341
Priya S: Snapshot of current backup failures: 3/7 daily snapshots in eu-west failed checksum. Log snippet:
```
2026-03-18T03:02:11Z backup: snapshot-save failed: checksum-mismatch
region=eu-west id=eu-az2
```
Ben J: For the smoke restore: script outline:
```
1) fetch latest snapshot
2) restore to sandbox cluster
3) run health-checks / smoke-tests
```
I'll add a simple automation that posts status to #incidents when done.
Maya R: Owners & ETA roundup: routing drift -> Ivan L (4d), backup verify -> Priya S (PR Tue, script Fri), restore runbook -> Ben J (draft Wed), tabletop -> Maya R & ops-oncall (45m, Thu 11:00). If any of you need to shift dates, update the tracker by EOD today.
oncall-bot: Scheduled incident drill: 2026-03-26T11:00:00Z, channel #dr-drill-2380056789. Invitees: SRE rotation + netops + prod-eng.
Ivan L: One blocker: need a staging route-proxy with mirror traffic. @infra-team can we carve out 2h of staging bandwidth next Tue?
Priya S: Also will add a validation run to CI: exit non-zero if smoke restore fails more than twice in a row. This should catch recurring backup bitrot.
Ben J: Linking runbook checklist I used before: /confluence/runbooks/restore-minimal. Will adapt and publish a shorter version for the drill.
Maya R: Thanks. I'll convert this thread into the tracker rows and assign follow-up reminders. We should also capture recurring incident pattern notes: intermittent EU spike -> correlated with backup window overlap. We'll add a hypothesis to the ticket.
Ivan L: Added hypothesis note to INC-7341.
Maya R: Closing loop: please post PR links and the rehearsal script here when ready so I can brief execs after the drill. :white_check_mark:
